findings.ownership_disposition: Resolved narrowly by project binding, canonical authorization roots, per-agent grants, bounded execution, and an operator-owned persisted policy. The current schema-v2 policy is enabled on clean installs. Released schema-v1 configs persisted no provenance capable of distinguishing the shipped disabled default from a user-chosen false value, so their disabled state migrates to enabled; explicit schema-v2 opt-outs record provenance and remain disabled. Agent or model arguments cannot change that policy. shell_exec retains its synchronous login-Bash compatibility contract; clean-profile bash.run is additive. Native Settings execution remains deferred under FC-SHELL-COMPAT-QUALIFICATION-001 and FC-UI-QUALIFICATION-001, so this resolved security finding is not a shell-qualification claim.

findings.ownership_disposition: Descriptor-relative traversal and bounded quarantine-and-verify mitigate final-component substitution but do not eliminate it. The current partial P10 boundary routes non-directory leaf deletion through a separately signed root LaunchDaemon, an authenticated exact-caller XPC contract, a root-owned same-volume mode-0700 namespace, 32 fixed transaction slots, exclusive descriptor-relative capture, post-capture identity and authorization checks, durable intent/captured/rollback/committed phases, and fail-closed retained rollback recovery. Automatic privileged restore through a recorded or reopened source-parent descriptor is disabled because same-UID relocation after validation could otherwise make root restore one captured leaf outside the authorized root. Protocol v4 adds exact pathless query, resume, and acknowledgement operations; terminal committed, restored, and rejected outcomes are never recycled until exact durable acknowledgement, and a full ledger fails closed. An owner-only bounded caller ledger is persisted before XPC submission and retained until daemon acknowledgement; it is availability state, not daemon authority. An existing transaction with wrong requester/project/generation/root authority cannot be acknowledged. Broker replay does not infer completion from pathname absence after dispatch and does not redispatch an ambiguous protected delete. This is mitigation, not elimination. Public macOS openat/fstatat/unlinkat/renameat/renameatx_np APIs do not combine mutation with an expected source device/inode/vnode-generation predicate. A same-UID writer can still swap the source before exclusive capture or change ACL/BSD metadata through a retained descriptor or hard link after the last check. The maximum terminal impact of the remaining authorization-metadata race is deletion of the one captured expected regular file or symbolic link; a regular file can contain unbounded bytes. A pre-capture substitution can make one current entry temporarily unavailable or recovery-required; an unsupported directory can represent an unbounded subtree but is not eligible for terminal deletion. Writable descriptors and hard links prevent an immutable-content guarantee. With automatic restore disabled, one captured leaf per affected transaction can remain unavailable, up to the 32 protected slots per volume. The caller ledger remains below same-UID-owned application storage; a same-UID process can rename or remove the sole caller recovery handle without forging daemon authority. Up to 32 lost handles per protected volume can strand captured entries or terminal outcomes from normal query/resume/ack reachability and then make later protected mutations fail closed on capacity. Project-generation reset holds the caller-ledger lock across preflight, the resetting state, recheck, and generation advance. It cancels on visible authority and surfaces a distinct error when cancellation fails. Delete retention revalidates current project authority inside that same lock, so a normal request delayed behind reset cannot publish stale caller authority or reach XPC. Same-UID removal or relocation of already-retained records can hide live daemon transactions, and replacement of the locked inode after validation but before slot publication can split retention from reset and permit stale dispatch. Without daemon-owned discovery or generation revoke, maximum post-reset impact is up to 32 captured or terminally deleted expected leaves per protected volume; each regular file can contain unbounded bytes. Initial project authorization composition, binding revoke/garbage collection, automatic post-broker acknowledgement/discovery, directory/move/cross-volume privileged operations, whole-product freshness, and the full signed distinct-process adversarial/crash/volume/upgrade/Release matrices remain open. Unit and source tests are supporting evidence only. FC-FILESYSTEM-PATH-TOCTOU-001, E2, P10, G10, and G12 remain open.
findings.title: Filesystem mutation paths retain descriptor-relative race windows

findings.ownership_disposition: Source regressions cover clean-install enablement, accidental schema-v1 disabled-state migration, current schema-v2 explicit opt-out preservation, MCP tools/list registration, successful execution, and the established synchronous /bin/bash -lc shell_exec result contract. shell_exec remains distinct from additive clean-profile bash.run, and no shell path enters the privileged filesystem daemon. Signed Debug XCUI evidence EVID-20260830T153118Z-752f058222 proves Settings visibility, control persistence, and GUI relaunch at its exact revision. Current-source Debug and Release evidence EVID-20260830T184228Z-1bb02068b2 and EVID-20260830T184522Z-d43b1586b6 each pass 755 tests with two declared skips and zero failures. The guarded installed-artifact harness validates the ordinary signed app and staged identities, rejects pre-existing manager state and user-controlled symlink aliases, and has 14 passing focused tests in EVID-20260830T185902Z-ce0de2b7cb. Live run EVID-20260830T185444Z-7878ff2abf did not execute shell_exec: macOS denied launchctl bootstrap to the current automation-host process tree, the legacy launchctl load fallback returned without a running manager job, and the harness failed closed and restored the canonical job, plist, command link, and launchd disabled-state entry. A foreground Terminal run outside this host restriction and correction of the false-success fallback remain required. Until a successful signed shell_exec survives real app and installed-manager process restart while preserving the same setting and contract, shell qualification remains deferred and release-blocking.
findings.title: Shell compatibility qualification requires native Settings execution
